raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]It's as secluded as any nook or cranny gets. The rest of the visitors are all in the ballroom, still. No one's noticed us leave.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: It's as secluded as any nook or cranny gets. The rest of the visitors are all in the ballroom, still. No one's noticed us leave.
No, someone has.

raw: Not everyone loves to hang around in opulent halls with nothing to do, Allerdale thinks to herself.
content: Not everyone loves to hang around in opulent halls with nothing to do, Allerdale thinks to herself.

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]I don't understand. Why not choose today? The lion's finally left his den for once, and hardly any of the Guard are here.
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: I don't understand. Why not choose today? The lion's finally left his den for once, and hardly any of the Guard are here.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]An assassination can't solve anything, and it won't.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: An assassination can't solve anything, and it won't.

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]Don't tell me you're scared of the gallows, Mister Dutyman.
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: Don't tell me you're scared of the gallows, Mister Dutyman.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]Compared to your fear of poverty, I'd say getting hanged's a lighter affair for me.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: Compared to your fear of poverty, I'd say getting hanged's a lighter affair for me.

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]I'm SICK of spending my days with my brain and my wallet in others' hands. Chop-chop, please.
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: I'm SICK of spending my days with my brain and my wallet in others' hands. Chop-chop, please.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]Even if the elder dies, there's still the cubs. The crown will remain seated firm on their heads, muzzling us like draft animals.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: Even if the elder dies, there's still the cubs. The crown will remain seated firm on their heads, muzzling us like draft animals.

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]If we can kill one king, we can kill a second.
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: If we can kill one king, we can kill a second.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]Easier said. Listen, we have to be patient.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: Easier said. Listen, we have to be patient.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]The Steam Knights have all been sent out. By the time they return to Londinium, the dust will have settled.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: The Steam Knights have all been sent out. By the time they return to Londinium, the dust will have settled.

speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: What will they do then?

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]The same as those paragon few. They'll do nothing for their own gain, and everything for Victoria. Even if it won't be handy to support our actions, they'll understand the decisions from on high.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: The same as those paragon few. They'll do nothing for their own gain, and everything for Victoria. Even if it won't be handy to support our actions, they'll understand the decisions from on high.

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]Then that leaves the Royal Guard.
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: Then that leaves the Royal Guard.

speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: At the parade...

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]...contain every Knight of the Tower... the key is seizing the city Defense Forces...
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: ...contain every Knight of the Tower... the key is seizing the city Defense Forces...

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]...some dukes got fed up with it long ago...
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: ...some dukes got fed up with it long ago...

raw: Allerdale's face presses against cold plate, but sweat nevertheless drips down her forehead.
content: Allerdale's face presses against cold plate, but sweat nevertheless drips down her forehead.

raw: It grows harder and harder not to move a muscle, not to mention keeping her breathing stifled. The voices of the two figures grow gradually out of reach, then suddenly are right before her.
content: It grows harder and harder not to move a muscle, not to mention keeping her breathing stifled. The voices of the two figures grow gradually out of reach, then suddenly are right before her.

raw: For a blink, she quivers, trying as hard as she can not to let her body slip into view, curling even her toes in.
content: For a blink, she quivers, trying as hard as she can not to let her body slip into view, curling even her toes in.

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]Has this lousy thing always been here?
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: Has this lousy thing always been here?

speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: First-generation steam knight armor.

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]First-generation! That's over two hundred years ago. It's antique by now, isn't it? I'm sure it'd fetch a pretty price.
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: First-generation! That's over two hundred years ago. It's antique by now, isn't it? I'm sure it'd fetch a pretty price.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]Haven't you seen the family crest? It's House Cumberland's steam armor.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: Haven't you seen the family crest? It's House Cumberland's steam armor.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]Its old owner once stood before the Gaulish artillery in this, braced for three whole hours, just so His Majesty could flee unscathed together with his shattered people.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: Its old owner once stood before the Gaulish artillery in this, braced for three whole hours, just so His Majesty could flee unscathed together with his shattered people.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]Only during battlefield cleanup did people realize half this suit had been blown away, and the one inside may well have died soon after bombardment began—
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: Only during battlefield cleanup did people realize half this suit had been blown away, and the one inside may well have died soon after bombardment began—

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]—but even dead, knights still persevere in protecting their own king and kin, reluctant to fall so soon.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: —but even dead, knights still persevere in protecting their own king and kin, reluctant to fall so soon.

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]And here you're the one of Gaulish blood—I'm surprised you like reminiscing on these nobles' heroic deeds more than I do.
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: And here you're the one of Gaulish blood—I'm surprised you like reminiscing on these nobles' heroic deeds more than I do.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]Fundamentally... I just bear respect for those we can call heroes.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: Fundamentally... I just bear respect for those we can call heroes.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]Their belongings and your measuring of things don't mix. Even if this duke's home is razed to ash one day, the Cumberlands would never sell off this armor.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: Their belongings and your measuring of things don't mix. Even if this duke's home is razed to ash one day, the Cumberlands would never sell off this armor.

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]Hah... damned noble sense of honor, am I right? Utterly meaningless, in my view.
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: Hah... damned noble sense of honor, am I right? Utterly meaningless, in my view.

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]He's welcome to watch from his ivory tower all he likes, along with the rest of the dukes. No matter who the city's ruler nominally is, it won't make the dukes' authority any worse for wear, at least for the moment.
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: He's welcome to watch from his ivory tower all he likes, along with the rest of the dukes. No matter who the city's ruler nominally is, it won't make the dukes' authority any worse for wear, at least for the moment.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]If he took the prudent path, then he wouldn't be Cumberland.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: If he took the prudent path, then he wouldn't be Cumberland.

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]Why can't he just let go of his loyalty to the lions? With colossal change about to greet Victoria, you wish he'd recognize where his loyalty should lie, sooner rather than later.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: Why can't he just let go of his loyalty to the lions? With colossal change about to greet Victoria, you wish he'd recognize where his loyalty should lie, sooner rather than later.

speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: What's going on down there?

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]More men than you can count have surrounded the Duke's manor.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: More men than you can count have surrounded the Duke's manor.

speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: What?!

speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: Quiet. Listen carefully.

speaker: Victorian Officer
content: Intruders... Palace underground...

speaker: Victorian Officer
content: Blade... thieved...

raw: [name="Victorian Officer"]Seal off all major streets in Auchterigg... no one in or out...
speaker: Victorian Officer
content: Seal off all major streets in Auchterigg... no one in or out...

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]Can you hear what they're saying down there?
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: Can you hear what they're saying down there?

speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: They're searching for someone.

speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: Who?

raw: [name="Indistinct Officer"]His Majesty's entire Guard has moved out.
speaker: Indistinct Officer
content: His Majesty's entire Guard has moved out.

raw: [name="Obscured Merchant"]They couldn't know we're meeting here... could they? What do we do, sir?
speaker: Obscured Merchant
content: They couldn't know we're meeting here... could they? What do we do, sir?

raw: A faint noise comes from in front of them, a sound like someone gently drawing breath.
content: A faint noise comes from in front of them, a sound like someone gently drawing breath.
Allerdale's heart pounds.
